episodes.synopsis: While recruiting for the basketball club, the Seirin Private High school has managed to pick up some impressive players; a power house, former American player, and a member of the “Generation of Miracles.
episodes.title: I Am Kuroko

episodes.synopsis: Before anyone can become an official member of the Basketball Club, they first must do display courage. Afterwards, a surprising guest appears on the school grounds with a shocking offer.
episodes.title: I'm Serious

episodes.synopsis: Seirin basketball club is playing a practice game at Kaijo High School, the school where Kise attends. After a display of power from Kagami, it forces the Kaijo coach to take Seirin serious.
episodes.title: It's Better If I Can't Win

episodes.synopsis: The only way to stop Kise is to challenge him with a style he can't copy, Kurokos! The new offensive from Seirin is closing the point gap, until an injury might derail Serin's chance at victory.
episodes.title: Take Care of the Counter Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Serin is victorious against Kaijo, barely.  It is a shock to Kise, who has never lost in his life. After the game, another former Teiko Middle school player, Midorima, has a few words for Kise.
episodes.title: Your Basketball

episodes.synopsis: Serins first opponent in the inter-high tournament is Shinkyo high, a middle tier school until last year.  With the addition of a two meter tall, 87 kilogram player from Senegal, Shinkyo is a new threat to Serins championship hopes.
episodes.title: Let Me Tell You Two Things

episodes.synopsis: After their win over Shinkyo, Seirin goes on to crush their next few opponents. Realizing too much confidence is brewing, the team is taken to watch a Shutoku match. After seeing how Shutoku, one of the three Emperor teams of basketball, dominates their opposition, the team realizes they have a long way to go if they are to improve and contend for the title.
episodes.title: You'll See Something Amazing

episodes.synopsis: Seirin takes on Seiho, a squad built around an invincible defense. The unorthodox manner in the way Seiko moves is finally understood, but it may be too late. Will Seirin's streak finally be shutdown?
episodes.title: Now That I Think About It

episodes.synopsis: Seirin's game continues against Seiho with neither team giving up points.  Kuroko and Kagami are pulled after the first quarter, to preserve their strength. Can their team mates bring home the victory?
episodes.title: To Win

episodes.synopsis: Kuroko has rejoined the game in the final moments, but it seems that one of the players has him figured out. Seirin is playing hard, but if they win, will they have the strength to play a 2nd game
episodes.title: I Can't Have That

episodes.synopsis: Seirin is holding their own against Shutoku, but in the 2nd half Midorima and Takao’s abilities are unleashed, shutting down Seirin’s game completely
episodes.title: That's Not It

episodes.synopsis: The pressure of the game is causing Kagami skills to rapidly increase; he continues to score keeping Seirin in the game. But his thoughts are turning darker and self-serving
episodes.title: What Is "Victory"

episodes.synopsis: With only 10 minutes left, Seirin is in trouble.  Kagami has run out of gas and Midorima shows no sign of stopping.  Kuroko is back in the game with a new, but dangerous pass.
episodes.title: I Believed in You

episodes.synopsis: After an awkward dinner involving rival basketball teams, Kuroko happens upon a dog that looks just like him. The dog quickly gathered favor with everybody except for one.
episodes.title: You Look Just Like Him

episodes.synopsis: Kuroko explains part of the history of the "Generation of Miracle" to Kagami.
episodes.title: Don't Make Me Laugh

episodes.synopsis: Even without Aomine, Touou Academy is dominating against Seirin.  It is an uphill battle against Touou Academy individual style of play and the genius of Satsuki.
episodes.title: Let's Go

episodes.synopsis: In a few minutes of play, Aomie has demonstrated why he is a force to be reckoned with, with Kuroko benched in the 2nd half, will the team be able to hold Aomie off?
episodes.title: You're All Ridiculous

episodes.synopsis: Aomie is unstoppable, but Serin hasn't given up yet. But with Kagami pulled in the last few minutes, can the team play without him?
episodes.title: No!!

episodes.synopsis: The only thing you can do is pick yourself up and move on. Some can move on faster, while others wallow in their own darkness. A new beginning and an old friend is what needed to pick the team back up.
episodes.title: On to a New Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Kiyoshi has a plan for Kuroko and Kagami to get them over their slump. Kuroko, on the other hand, think he needs to be pulled.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to Be

episodes.synopsis: The training camp from hell has begun.
episodes.title: Let's Get Started

episodes.synopsis: The training camp is over and everyone has learned something about themselves. But the team is not ready to leave yet, as there is a game happening: Kaijo vs Touou, Kise Ryota vs Aomine Daiki.
episodes.title: I'll Win Even If It Kills Me

episodes.synopsis: Kise copy technique has lead Kaijo to take the early lead. With Touou keeping pace, Aomine is enjoying the pressure and is getting better each minute.
episodes.title: I'm Not Mature!

episodes.synopsis: Touou Academy has not stolen the game like expected. If they can’t break away, Kise will finally reach full potential.
episodes.title: Don't Get the Wrong Idea

episodes.synopsis: The game has reached a fever pitch and some of the players are about to break. Can Kise keep up copy of Aomine or will Aomine finally be able to go all out.
episodes.title: Our Basketball
